description: This file contains core plugin management and dynamic object handling functions for a device management API, including plugin loading, dynamic node cleanup, and object matching.

methods.name: void free_all_dynamic_nodes(DMOBJ * entryobj)
methods.description: Recursively frees all dynamically allocated nodes within a DMOBJ structure, including nested dynamic objects and leaves.

methods.name: int plugin_obj_match(const char * in_param,struct dmnode * node)
methods.description: Checks if the current node matches the input parameter string, updating the 'matched' field.

methods.name: void dm_check_dynamic_obj(struct list_head * mem_list,DMNODE * parent_node,DMOBJ * entryobj,const char * full_obj,DMOBJ ** root_entry)
methods.description: Recursively searches dynamic objects for a match with the full object path.

methods.name: void dm_check_dynamic_obj_entry(struct list_head * mem_list,DMNODE * parent_node,DMOBJ * entryobj,const char * parent_obj,const char * full_obj,DMOBJ ** root_entry)
methods.description: Checks individual dynamic object entries against the target full object path.

methods.name: DMOBJ * find_entry_obj(DMOBJ * entryobj,const char * obj_path)
methods.description: Finds and returns a specific entry object within a larger object based on the object path.

methods.name: void disable_entry_obj(DMOBJ * entryobj,const char * obj_path,const char * parent_obj,const char * plugin_path)
methods.description: Disables (excludes) a specific object entry based on its path and plugin info.

methods.name: void disable_entry_leaf(DMOBJ * entryobj,const char * leaf_path,const char * parent_obj,const char * plugin_path)
methods.description: Disables (excludes) a leaf parameter based on its path.

methods.name: int get_entry_obj_idx(DMOBJ * entryobj)
methods.description: Returns the index of the given entry object in its list.

methods.name: int get_entry_leaf_idx(DMLEAF * entryleaf)
methods.description: Returns the index of the given leaf in its list.

methods.name: int get_obj_idx(DMOBJ ** entryobj)
methods.description: Returns the index of the object within an array of object pointers.

methods.name: int get_leaf_idx(DMLEAF ** entryleaf)
methods.description: Returns the index of the leaf within an array of leaf pointers.

methods.name: void load_plugins(DMOBJ * dm_entryobj,const char * plugin_path)
methods.description: Loads plugin modules from a specified directory, handling both JSON and shared object files.

methods.name: void free_plugins(DMOBJ * dm_entryobj)
methods.description: Frees all dynamically allocated plugin-related data structures and resources.

methods.name: int compare(const struct dirent ** a,const struct dirent ** b)
